scope: Targeted source audit for new catalog; not a complete classification of all automatic/random-event missions.

entries.finding: Primary category selection, including DES/RAN and multiple subvariants.
Modern menu expands RAN on client before server request.
Periodic empty-argument mission request is a native random mission request; new guard rejects it.
Conversation directly schedules refugee/informer/prisoner/deserter variants and owns a dialog-mission flag; must adapt flag lifecycle and response text.
Map action directly schedules SUPP_Supplies, bypassing category selection.
Convoy-route intelligence directly schedules convoy with destination, origin and legacy arguments; update reported route and task together.
Strategic town attacks also call convoy; distinguish already-adapted infected strategic attacks from requested interception objectives.
Direct conquest can forward to competitive conquest; cannot retain this route for new Liquidation.
Native competitive route can forward back to ordinary conquest.
Requires nonhuman civilians, uses Invader-side special, adds SF troops or attack helicopter; unsuitable as a simple renamed infected-only target task.
Native permanent-site ownership transaction restricts Rebel bases/airfields to war level 3; preserve restriction.
Native town transaction includes ownership/support changes, nearby administration capture and delayed tier maintenance; account for these effects when wiring clearance.
